Data & Research Ethics

How Client & Contact Data Is Handled

Applies to: Every engagement, every account list, every contact record.

All case studies on this page are anonymized to protect client confidentiality. No private contact details, personal emails, phone numbers, or individual profiles are ever displayed publicly without explicit authorization.

Standing Commitments
  • Client & account names anonymized in all public materials
  • Contact-level data shared only with the commissioning client
  • Human review before any list leaves the research process
In short: Rigorous research, discreetly handled — your account data stays yours.

The Process

🔬 Research Methodology

Our systematic approach to uncovering high-fit accounts and decision-makers.

Our ABM research process combines account analysis, ICP alignment, buying committee mapping, and human-reviewed research workflows to create actionable sales intelligence. We focus heavily on data precision, structural role mapping, and tailoring insights directly to enterprise sales teams.

1. ICP Alignment

Defining exact firmographic and technographic parameters for target accounts.

2. Committee Mapping

Identifying economic buyers, technical evaluators, and business champions.

3. Human Review

Validating contact structures and context through multi-step quality checks.

Questions

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Why should I use ABM instead of buying lead lists? +

Lead lists contain unverified, often outdated contacts. ABM focuses on accounts that fit your ICP, with human-reviewed buying committee research and personalized messaging, resulting in higher reply rates and better engagement quality.

How fast can I see results? +

Typically, you can expect the first qualified meetings within 2-3 weeks. A full pipeline usually builds over 30-60 days, depending on your ACV and sales cycle.

What makes your approach different? +

I use technographic research (like Salesforce usage) to identify high-fit accounts, map buying committees, and carefully review every profile. No recycled lists, no spam — just precision.

What tools power the research? +

Industry-standard platforms — Apollo.io, Snov.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Hunter.io, NeverBounce, and HubSpot CRM — combined with a 100% human review pass before anything reaches your inbox.
